name: Do I need an electrician for bathroom lighting upgrades?

mainEntity.name: Do I need an electrician for bathroom lighting upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most bathroom lighting upgrades, especially those involving new wiring, relocating fixtures, or installing higher-voltage systems, hiring a qualified electrician is strongly recommended. This ensures compliance with local electrical codes, proper grounding, and safe operation. While simple fixture replacements might be considered DIY by some, professional installation prevents potential hazards and ensures longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: A qualified electrician is recommended for most bathroom lighting upgrades, particularly those involving new wiring or fixture relocation, to ensure safety and code compliance.
